text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Oguri-senpai! Is it true that you were 
walking down the hallway eating ramen 
yesterday?!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. An urgent matter arose while I was 
eating. Still, it would be terribly rude 
to the cook if I were to let the ramen go 
soggy.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Is that what happened...? Excessive 
snacking on the go isn't something I can 
overlook as a Hall Monitor, but given the 
circumstances, it can't be helped!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Still, the soup might spill and burn you, 
so I'd appreciate it if you wouldn't do 
that anymore.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I'll be more careful from now 
on. Thank you for understanding.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"No, it's only natural. You can't go 
letting food go to waste, after all."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
By the way, what was that urgent errand 
about?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I heard they're handing out cupcakes 
to the first 20 people in the Home Ec 
room...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
This wasn't what I thought we were doing 
at all!
